mapper.select: select date(create_time) as localDate, coalesce(count(*), 0) as userCount from user where create_time >= #{startTime} and create_time <= #{endTime} group by date(create_time) order by localDate

select date(order_time) as localDate, count(*) as totalOrderCount, sum(case when status = 5 then 1 else 0 end) as validOrderCount from orders where order_time >= #{begin} and order_time <= #{end} group by date(order_time) order by localDate
